title: Endangerment offenses.
bodyText:
(a) Any person subject to this chapter who engages in conduct that:

(1) Is wrongful and reckless or is wanton; and

(2) Is likely to produce death or grievous bodily harm to another person,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

(b) Any person subject to this chapter who:

(1) Fights or promotes a fight, or is concerned in or connives a fight; or

(2) Having knowledge of a challenge to fight sent or about to be sent, fails to report the facts promptly to the proper authority,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

(c) Any person subject to this chapter who, wilfully and wrongly, discharges a firearm under circumstances as to endanger human life shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

(d) Any person subject to this chapter who unlawfully carries a dangerous weapon concealed on or about their person shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml:
[§124B-180]  Endangerment offenses.  (a)  Any person subject to this chapter who engages in conduct that:

     (1)  Is wrongful and reckless or is wanton; and

     (2)  Is likely to produce death or grievous bodily harm to another person,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

     (b)  Any person subject to this chapter who:

     (1)  Fights or promotes a fight, or is concerned in or connives a fight; or

     (2)  Having knowledge of a challenge to fight sent or about to be sent, fails to report the facts promptly to the proper authority,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

     (c)  Any person subject to this chapter who, wilfully and wrongly, discharges a firearm under circumstances as to endanger human life shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.

     (d)  Any person subject to this chapter who unlawfully carries a dangerous weapon concealed on or about their person shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
